elements.text:
Two new enchantments you will encounter in a magical world, and an ordinary /benchanting table/z will offer them both.

  /bMagic Protection/z guards against the harm no armour turns aside: the spells of witches, the venom of a potion thrown, the bite of a curse. Each level of it turns away a fifth of that damage, so a full set carrying the fourth level leaves only a fifth to reach you. It sits on armour, and like the other protections it will not share a piece with them.

  /bMana Repair/z is the rarer find. Set upon anything that wears, it mends that one thing and nothing else, drawing a point of /bmana/z for a point of repair, once each second. It will not touch your pool below fifty, so a tired magician mends nothing until they have rested. Every enchanted tool tends only to itself, so a wand and a pickaxe both bearing it each draw their own mana.
